notes.title: FISHGUN Patch Notes
notes.content:
Changes

 Peach bosses now take more damage from mega missiles and wide/tall spread upgrade
 Decals (fruit splats, acid pools, damage indicators, etc.) now ignore enemies and other dynamic objects
 Decals no longer appear all stretched when intersecting with vertical surfaces

notes.title: FISHGUN Patch Notes
notes.content:
Changes

 Swarm bullets now always have one bounce and can bounce off enemies
 Increased laser range by ~20%
 MAYHEM healing from food now eventually drops to 12% rather than 5%
 Changed the platforming section inside of the temple
 The entry door to the final room in A Fishy Beginning now closes after entering
 Fixed fish copter doors not opening if players get in too soon
 Added ambient acid pool sounds

notes.title: The MAYHEM Update
notes.content:
The MAYHEM Update is here! Fight an endless horde of enemies and survive as long as you can.

Update Notes


 Added MAYHEM mode, with 4 maps
 Increased height of light lines on dropped food to make them more visible
 Switched default Eat binding to 'E' and added an option to rebind it
 Added an option to limit FPS
 Kill and death stats are now shown in the main menu
 Fixed a bug which would sometimes cause a flash as the screen fades out after dying
 Added FRED

notes.title: FISHGUN at Play NYC
notes.content:
Play NYC 2023 is the 8th iteration of the collection of developers both small and large to show off their new projects to both the industry and the public. 

The event will run from August 5th to the 6th at the metropolitan pavilion in Manhattan, and feature PC, Console, board games and everything in-between for attendees to demo. 

If you're in the area we'd love to meet you and show off the new gamemode we've been working on.

Link to Play NYC: https://play-nyc.com/ 

Keep on blasting fruit,
- The FISHGUNNERS

notes.title: A FISHY UPDATE
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone who’s played FISHGUN over the last few days! We’re glad you’re having fun with the fish god. We’ll have some big updates coming soon, but for now we’ve added a few quality-of-life features:


 Added a field of view slider (80-120 degrees)
 Added an accessibility slider to turn down screen shake
 Added an accessibility slider to turn down headbob
 Added an accessibility toggle to disable gamepad rumble
 Added an option to enable a speedrun timer
 Fixed a bug which caused plugged in gamepads to vibrate when playing with mouse & keyboard


Please feel free to give us any feedback with any suggestions or bugs you find!
